title: Mall Craze
description:
Have you ever strolled through your local mall and thought to yourself: 

“I could totally build something like this myself!” 

Well, now you can! Mall Craze is a Shopping Center Management game where you become the architect and owner of your very own mall! 

Build Your Dream MallWhether you want to replicate your favorite real-world shopping center or let your imagination run wild with a unique design, ultimately, the choice is yours! 

Choose from an array of shops and create a mall that stands out from the rest. 

Customize Every DetailWho says all malls have to look the same? 
With Mall Craze, you have the power to personalize every aspect of your mall. 
Want a sleek, modern design? No problem. Prefer a cozy, rustic vibe? 
The options are there for you! 

Become the ManagerOnce your mall is built, it's time to put on your managerial hat.

Hire experienced cashiers (or make tough decisions and let underperforming employees go), launch strategic advertising campaigns, secure financing through bank loans, and fine-tune your pricing strategy to maximize profits.

With smart decisions, your mall will financially thrive in no time! 

Curious to see how far your architectorial, creative & managerial talents can take you?
description_short: Build, Customize & Manage your own shopping center! Choose from modern gaming hardware store to cozy flower shop. Hire skilled cashiers, secure financing through bank loans, and launch strategic advertising campaigns to make your mall thrive!
